description:
Shown in the property report as the 'Street Profile' table in the Market
section.

The property's own street: current median price, 2/4/8-year price
forecasts, realised growth, sale/rental turnover, renter share and
houses/units on the street — plus the suburb-wide medians to judge it
against and the street's rank on 4-year forecast growth.

404s when the street has no forecast row rather than falling back to
suburb-wide figures, which would answer a different question.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
